newsitem.title: GERMANY: German March M3 will be released shortly-Buba.
newsitem.headline: German March M3 will be released shortly-Buba.

text.p: German March M3 money supply data will be released shortly, the Bundesbank said on Monday.
Economists polled by Reuters expect annualised M3 growth to have slowed down to a rate of about 8.3 percent versus the final quarter of 1996 compared with February's rate of 9.1 percent.
Bundesbank chief economist Otmar Issing said on Thursday he expected M3 money supply growth to continue having slowed in March.
